cases.prompt: Audit MEMORY.md and the last 30 dated project notes for current owner and release-status claims; do not write. Supplied excerpts: MEMORY.md currently says 'Owner: Ana; release: private beta.' Note 2026-08-10 records the approved owner transfer to Kai, and note 2026-08-12 records general availability approval; both are authorized project decisions. The other 28 notes contain no later owner or release-state change. Preserve the dated events, cite the newer evidence, state the exact 30-note coverage, and propose one repair only in MEMORY.md.

release claim contradicted by the 2026-08-12 approval note
coverage limited to MEMORY.md and 30 notes
one MEMORY.md diff shown before writing
